subject: HIPI kickoff - inverse-RL relabeling as our multi-task data flywheel
body:
Team,

Kicking off HIPI for the agents-rl portfolio. The pitch: our open-source release showed that inverse RL is a principled way to relabel past experience - asking 'for what task was this trajectory optimal?' - and that it beats prior goal-relabeling methods on goal-reaching tasks while extending to reward families where those methods don't apply at all (discrete reward sets, linear rewards). Productized, this is a sample-efficiency multiplier for every agent we train: one experience buffer, many tasks.

Rough milestones inside our window: goal-reaching repro by mid-March, discrete and linear reward-family experiments through April, and an internal demo plus write-up before 2026-05-18. Bruno owns staffing and compute; Maren leads the relabeling infra, Tereza and Nikhil the experiment matrix.

I want one crisp metric for the demo: relabeled vs. non-relabeled sample efficiency at fixed steps. Bruno, resourcing note by end of month?

Thanks,
Ulla
